# VB Distribution opens 100,000 sq ft Lancashire warehouse ahead of vape duty

 By Kiran Paul 

July 16, 2026

VB Distribution opens new Lancashire warehouse complex (Photo: Handout)

VB Distribution has opened a new warehouse and trade counter complex in Lancashire, adding 100,000 sq ft of HMRC-approved bonded warehousing to its UK network as the vaping industry prepares for the introduction of the Vaping Products Duty in October.

The new business park increases the company’s national depot footprint to 500,000 sq ft and forms part of its long-term expansion strategy. The distributor said the investment strengthens its customs bonded warehouse operation, enabling duty-suspended storage and helping customers manage the financial impact of the new tax regime.

The Vaping Products Duty comes into force on 1 October 2026, requiring businesses to pay duty on vaping products. VB Distribution said expanded bonded warehouse capacity would allow retailers and wholesalers to hold stock without immediately incurring duty costs, helping to manage cash flow and reduce the risk of sudden price increases.

# SJH Fulfilment invests £3.5m in Greater Belfast expansion

 September 7, 2026 

 

SJH Fulfilment has announced a £3.5 million investment in a new 46,000 sq ft Greater Belfast fulfilment facility, more than doubling its total warehousing footprint and supporting 25 permanent jobs at the site within the next three years.

The new facility takes the company’s total warehousing footprint in Northern Ireland to 83,500 sq ft, up from 37,500 sq ft at its Kilkeel base. The additional capacity will support larger fulfilment contracts across the fashion, wellness and beauty sectors, while marking the launch of a new 10-year growth strategy targeting revenues of £50 million by 2036. Five full-time employees have already been recruited at the new site, with a further 20 permanent roles expected to be created over the next three years. An additional 10 seasonal positions will be added this winter.

results.text:
Amazon to set up 'logistics site' in Mill Hill - Barnet Post

# Amazon to set up ‘logistics site’ in Mill Hill

11 August, 2026 12:53 pm 1 Min Read

The company says the delivery station at Pentavia Retail Park will create 80 jobs when it opens in October

An Amazon delivery station – (Credit – Amazon)

An online giant says it is “excited” to be investing in Mill Hill as it prepares to open a new delivery station in October.

Amazon will open the 100,000 square foot site at Pentavia Retail Park in Mill Hill and says it will bring “approximately 80 new jobs” to the area. 

The company says that salaries for “full time on-site roles” start at £31,824 a year. 

They say the site will serve customers across the Barnet area and will also create “hundreds of additional driver opportunities” through its delivery service partners programme. 

Prajvin Prakash, country director for Amazon Logistics, said: “We’re excited to be investing in this area with a new delivery station that will create permanent roles for the local workforce here, and help us deliver even faster for customers.”

results.author: Mike Macdonald
results.text:
VB Distribution Expands Ahead of UK’s Vape Duty Change - Tobacco Reporter

# VB Distribution Expands Ahead of UK’s Vape Duty Change

VB Distribution announced the opening of a new 100,000-square-foot business park in Lancashire, England, expanding its national warehousing network to 500,000 square feet and strengthening its customs bonded storage capacity ahead of the U.K.’s Vaping Products Duty, which takes effect on Oct. 1. The company said the HMRC-approved bonded warehouse will allow duty-suspended storage, helping retailers better manage inventory and cash flow as the new tax is implemented.

Company CEO Natalia Gosciniak said the investment positions VB Distribution to provide compliant stock and supply continuity, alleviating cost pressures faced by smaller distributors without bonded infrastructure. VB Distribution, which supplies more than 50,000 retail shelf placements across the U.K. and reports an annual turnover of £500 million, said the facility is fully operational and could create up to 1,000 jobs as part of its broader expansion strategy.

# Online grocer Ocado Retail secures last mile fulfilment centre in Stoke

Posted on Tuesday 21 July 2026 Share: 

Online grocer Ocado has secured a last mile fulfilment centre at developer investor Indurent’s Indurent Park Stoke Central scheme in the West Midlands.

By Liza Helps, Property Editor, Logistics Matters

OCADO HAS taken unit C55 – the last available warehouse on the 530,000 ft2 Stoke Central development – on a 15-year lease at a rent thought to be close to the asking rent of circa £524,700 per year (£9.49 per ft2).

The facility which totals 55,232 ft2 features 10m eavesand a floor loading capacity of 50kN per m2. It has 48,355 ft2 of warehouse space with five dock and two level access doors served by a 50m yard with parking for seven HGVs.

The building also benefits form 3,714 ft2 of office space as well as a 3,136 ft2 plant deck. It was built to achieve BREEAM Excellent and an EPC A rating.

The building also incorporates rooftop solar PV and EV charging infrastructure, which Ocado will use to house, maintain and charge its growing fleet of electric delivery vehicles.

# Warehouse pioneers robotics system used in China

Image source, Kate Bradbrook/BBC

Image caption, Brian Luck says the Northampton warehouse is a "pioneering site" with its robotic system

By Kate Bradbrook, in Northampton and Louise Parry

27 September 2026

A new giant warehouse in England's logistics "golden triangle" is adopting pioneering technology previously only used in China, a company said.

Yusen Logistics UK said it will use a robotics and four-way conveyor system at its new site on the edge of Northampton, which will also employ hundreds of staff.

"There are some roles that robots can do better than people, but fundamentally robots don't work without people," said David Evans, the company's managing director.

The Japanese firm opened its 1.1m sq ft (102,193 sq m) site with a fusion ceremony that included a traditional counting song, sushi, and fish and chips.

# Aldi hiring 600 people to work at its new Bardon distribution centre

16 October, 2026 | by Angela Beevers

Aldi is creating 600 roles at its new automated distribution centre in Leicestershire as it builds up operations at the site over the next year.

The facility in Bardon, which opened in May and began fresh produce operations in September, is the supermarket’s first automated distribution centre in the UK.

Aldi has invested more than £500 million into the site as part of its £1.6 billion UK expansion plan.

Once fully operational, the facility will be the biggest supermarket distribution centre in the country, capable of moving around seven million pallets each year.

With recruitment now under way, Aldi said the roles will include warehouse operations, logistics and transport, with start dates over the next year.

The new facility at Indurent Park Gloucester in Quedgeley replaces the company’s previous operation in Tewkesbury, which had reached capacity. The investment will help Evri manage rising parcel volumes, strengthen regional operations and improve its ability to meet customer demand.

The depot has created 38 permanent roles across warehouse, driving, operational and management functions. The investment also supports local employment while providing additional capacity for the growing logistics business.

## A huge new distribution centre covering 1.2 million square feet has officially opened in Northampton, with around 150 people expected to be employed at the site.

Yusen Logistics opened its new Sustainable Distribution Centre on Thursday, September 24, marking a major investment in the town's logistics industry.

The facility combines automated warehouse technology with a range of environmentally friendly features, including solar energy generation, rainwater harvesting and electric vehicle charging infrastructure.

It has also achieved a BREEAM Outstanding rating, one of the highest standards for sustainable building performance.
